author: MiniWarGaming
description:
In 1998 Starcraft the video game came out, and I was a huge fan.  Now 28 years later it finally has its own miniature wargame!

Archon Studios sponsored us and sent us everything we needed to play their new miniature wargame.  Luka and I (Matthew) took control of Jim Raynor and Sarah Kerrigan, Queen of Blades, and faced off in this skirmish scale game of Starcraft.

Pre-order Starcraft The Miniatures Game Here:  https://www.miniwargaming.com/starcraft

*A couple notes on rules clarifications:*
- You do not score any points in the first round
- At 39:24, resources cannot be gathered if the point was not controlled earlier
